summary: Brand Engagement Network Inc. filed an 8-K on September 22, 2026, disclosing a September 21, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement with BEN Capital Fund I, LLC and Joseph Bevash for a private placement of 123,650 common shares at $8.50 per share, totaling $1,051,025. The price reflects a premium exceeding 20% to the $7.07 close on September 21, 2026. Funding occurs via an initial $150,025 tranche for 17,650 shares plus five monthly installments of $180,200 each for 21,200 shares. The deal includes 100% warrant coverage at $8.50 with six-month terms and piggy-back registration rights. This is a routine unregistered equity financing, not a special situation; dilution from shares and warrants bears watching.
